plain: Joining one thing on to a larger one, such as a territory added to a nation.

webster.text: The act of annexing, or uniting at the end; conjunction; addition; the act of connecting; union.

example.quote: The province of Maine is already considered as approaching the term of its annexation to it; and Pa. will probably not increase, considering the present state of her population, & other events that may happen.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, June 29, 1787
